paragraphs.text: # dsh-db-workspace
English · 简体中文
A database connection manager for DSH's right sidebar. Configure connections, edit multiple connecti
ons in the list, and test availability without leaving the app.
Repository · Download source
## Features

- Search by alias, driver, host, database, or user; refresh the list and set a default connection.
-
Expand editors inside their connection cards. Multiple editors can stay open with independent draft

s.
- Collapse and search without losing unsaved edits. Saving or cancelling closes only that editor;

failed saves retain input.
- Add connections, test saved connections or unsaved drafts, and delete

with inline confirmation.
- View notifications at the top of the panel, with theme-aware controls an

d responsive form columns.
- Display usernames and mask stored passwords. On supported Windows accou
nts, reveal a password after native account-password verification.
Supports Kingbase, PostgreSQL, MySQL, Oracle, and OceanBase (MySQL or Oracle tenant mode). The plugi
n also provides read-only SQL queries and schema inspection. It inspects SQL words instead of keywor
d substrings in field names. Reads use read-only transactions; writes, DDL and maintenance require o
ne-time user approval through `db_execute`.
## Installation
Requires a compatible DeepSeek Harness host with sidebar, locale, remote command, and tool services,
plus Node.js and npm. This is an application plugin, not a standalone website. The built `client.js
and npm. This is an application plugin, not a standalone website. The built `client.js` is included.
[代码示例省略，未执行]
Replace `<profile-directory>` with the app's active profile. Restart DSH and open **Database connect
ions** from the right sidebar or Start page guide.
If the environment supplies `DSH_PROFILE_DIR`, `node install.mjs` uses it automatically. Otherwise t
he script resolves `<DSH_HOME>/profiles/<DSH_PROFILE or desktop>`, with `~/.dsh` as the fallback hom
e. The desktop app may use a different home; prefer its actual profile path. The installer adds a lo
cal `link:` dependency, a bundle entry, and a directory junction. Keep the checkout in place afterwa
`link:` dependency, a bundle entry, and a directory junction. Keep the checkout in place afterwards.
Connection aliases may contain Chinese characters, ASCII letters, digits, hyphens and underscores. S
tart with a Chinese character, letter or digit; the maximum length is 64 characters. Spaces and othe
r punctuation are not supported. Renaming retains stored credentials and updates the default alias w
re not supported. Renaming retains stored credentials and updates the default alias when applicable.
## Local configuration
The public `cordis.patch.yml` uses the host defaults below. Keep personal configuration overrides ou
t of public commits.
| Field | Purpose | Default |
| `configPath` | Connection JSON file | `DSH_DB_CONFIG_PATH`, then current profile/home (see below)

|
| `driverDirectory` | Directory containing driver `node_modules` | Parent of `configPath` |
| `con

nectTimeoutMs` | Driver connection timeout, ms | `10000` |
| `testTimeoutMs` | Connection probe dead
Install the packages needed for your connections in `driverDirectory`:
| Connection type | Packages |

| Kingbase / PostgreSQL | `pg`, `pg-connection-string` |
| MySQL | `mysql2` |
| Oracle | `oracledb`

|
| OceanBase | `oceanbase` |
For example: `npm install --prefix "<driver-directory>" pg pg-connection-string`.
This is a **fictional example**, not a working configuration. Replace the values privately, or creat
e connections through the UI.
[代码示例省略，未执行]
For an existing connection with an unchanged driver, blank connection-string and password inputs ret
ain stored values. To replace a password, enter a new one and save. Saves back up the previous file
as `<file>.bak`, write `<file>.tmp`, and rename it into place.
## Default database tools on every device
Enabling the plugin registers its own system-prompt section: use db_connections first to resolve ali
ases, then db_test_connection, db_query, db_schema or the approval-gated db_execute. Tool errors and
blocked queries must be reported without automatically falling back to terminal scripts. This is mo
del guidance, not a sandbox restriction on other tools.
Explicit plugin configuration takes precedence. Otherwise configPath uses DSH_DB_CONFIG_PATH, then D
SH_PROFILE_DIR/db-config.json, DSH_HOME/db-config.json, and finally ~/.dsh/db-config.json. Drivers u
se explicit driverDirectory, then DSH_DB_DRIVER_DIRECTORY, then the connection file parent. Existing
explicit paths are preserved; nothing is migrated or uploaded. On another device install the plugin
in the active profile, install drivers there, add local connections in the panel, and select a defa
ult alias. Restart the app to load the tools and policy.
queryTimeoutMs defaults to 30000 (1000–480000). db_query accepts env, sql and limit (default 100, ma
ximum 1000). db_schema accepts env, optional table/schema and limit; omit table to list tables, prov
ide it to list columns (not a complete DDL/index export). Schema filters use driver-specific bound p
arameters. Returned row limits only bound output, not server work: add an appropriate SQL row limit.
Operations run in dedicated database processes. Completion, cancellation or timeout terminates the
process before the tool returns, closing its sockets. Read-only credentials are recommended because
database functions and external effects are not a SQL sandbox. UPDATE_TIME and CREATE_USER are valid
field names. Multiple statements, executable comments and unsupported procedural calls are rejected
; never bypass a rejection.
## Approval and connection lifetime
SQL policy is implemented in sql-policy.js; guardQuery in query.js is the read-only entry. Word boun
daries, comments and quoted values are inspected without changing SQL text. db_query cannot execute
DML, DDL or analysis. Use db_execute to request host approval for the exact connection and single SQ
L statement. Missing approval UI, rejection or cancellation terminates before connection creation. A
I-supplied approval flags are not accepted. No write approval is persisted or reused.
EXPLAIN (including ANALYZE), ANALYZE, VACUUM, OPTIMIZE and REINDEX also require approval and warn ab
out CPU/IO, scans, locks and possible impact on other users. EXPLAIN ANALYZE actually executes its s
tatement. DDL can implicitly commit; it is not generally rollback-safe. After timeout or disconnecti
on, write outcomes may be uncertain: verify before any retry.
